note.ended.awaits: Asked #{{awaits}} of another repository and waits for its answer; the quest goes on in the same tree once it is answered.
note.ended.turn-failed-taken: The agent's turn failed with the quest still taken:
note.ended.turn-failed-open: The agent's turn failed before it took its quest:
note.ended.parked-asked: It stopped with its quest still taken, to ask you:
note.ended.parked-transcript: It stopped with its quest still taken, to ask you; what it needs ends its transcript.
note.ended.answered-unfinished: It went on with #{{awaits}} answered, and ended with the quest still taken (exit {{exit}}).
note.ended.carried-unfinished: It carried the quest on, and ended with it still taken (exit {{exit}}).
note.ended.declined: The session declined; its reason is on the quest.
note.ended.stood-down: It exited cleanly with the quest taken: someone else has it.
note.ended.taken-exit: Exit {{exit}} with the quest still taken.
note.ended.untouched: It exited without touching its quest.
note.ended.went-on: It went on with your words and ended; its quest stays as it closed.
note.ended.went-on-exit: It went on with your words and exited {{exit}}; its quest stays as it closed.
note.ended.timeout: Timed out after {{minutes}} minutes and was killed.
note.ended.lost-claim: Stopped by this machine's driver: another machine's take on the quest reached the remote first, so this session's work would double someone else's.
note.ended.driver-closed: The driver was stopped while this ran; the session's process was ended with it.
note.account.cooling: The account it ran on is cooling until {{until}} ({{why}}); nothing starts on it until then.
note.account.cooling-window: The {{owner}} account it ran on hit its {{window}} limit and is cooling until {{until}} ({{why}}); nothing starts on it until then.
note.account.cooling-no-window: The {{owner}} account it ran on is cooling until {{until}} ({{why}}); nothing starts on it until then.
note.account.refused: Its provider refused the {{owner}} account it ran on (401). Replace the key or sign in again, in Settings or with `daoris agent`, and Daoris starts sessions on it again.
note.account.refused-own: Its provider refused {{owner}}'s own sign-in (401). Replace the key or sign in again, in Settings or with `daoris agent`, and Daoris starts sessions on it again.
note.account.signed-out: The agent refused the {{owner}} account it ran on for its sign-in, so it reads signed out and nothing more starts on it until it is signed in again, on the agent's page in Agents or with `daoris agent`.
note.account.signed-out-own: The agent refused {{owner}}'s own sign-in, so nothing more starts on it until you sign in again at your terminal and read it again on the agent's page in Agents.
note.account.resume-signed-out: That account is not signed in any more.
note.account.resume-gone: That account is not on this machine any more.
note.account.resume-outside: This work no longer uses that account.
note.account.resume-kept: That account is kept for conversations, which driven work never runs on.
note.account.resume-new-session: You chose a new session over waiting for that account.
note.started.tree: Opened a session tree on {{branch}}, from {{basedOn}}. A fresh tree holds nothing git does not track: no installed dependencies, no build outputs.
note.started.tree-unrecorded: Daoris could not record where its branch started, so bringing it up to date will cut where its work first differs from the line:
note.started.in-asking-tree: In the tree session {{session}} asked from.
note.started.words-open: Starts #{{quest}} with your words to session {{session}}.
note.started.words-taken: Carries #{{quest}} on with your words to session {{session}}.
note.started.answer: Carries #{{quest}} on with your answer to session {{session}}.
note.started.released: Carries #{{quest}} on: you stopped session {{session}}, and released it.
note.started.cut-off: Carries #{{quest}} on after session {{session}} was cut off.
note.started.same-tree: In the tree it worked in.
note.working.resumes-answer: Resumes its own conversation with your answer, in the tree it worked in.
note.working.goes-on: It goes on with your words in its own conversation, in the tree it worked in.
note.went.new-session: Your words went to a new session, because {{why}}.
note.went.carried-on: Carried on in a new session, because {{why}}.
note.intake.ask-deleted: The ask it answered was deleted while it ran.
note.intake.ask-closed: Ask #{{ask}} was closed while it ran:
note.intake.ask-answered: Ask #{{ask}} was answered while it ran: it became {{quests}}.
note.intake.turn-failed: The agent's turn failed before publishing anything onto ask #{{ask}}:
note.intake.asks: It published nothing: the declarations did not settle ask #{{ask}}, so it asks you rather than guess; its question ends its transcript. `daoris-driver ask --publish {{ask}} --to <repository>` answers it; `daoris-driver ask --close {{ask}} --reason "…"` ends it.
note.intake.exit: Exit {{exit}} before publishing anything onto ask #{{ask}}.
note.intake.person-answered: The person answered ask #{{ask}}: it became {{quests}}.
note.intake.person-deleted: The person deleted ask #{{ask}}, so there is nothing left for it to wait on.
note.stopped.checkpoint-finished: The person finished this at a checkpoint.
note.stopped.checkpoint-stopped: The person stopped this at a checkpoint.
note.stopped.checkpoint-moved: The person moved this at a checkpoint.
note.stopped.orphan: Nothing on this machine was running it any more: its process ended with the application that started it, and the record had not been told.
note.chat.closed: The application closed while this conversation ran; its process was ended with it.
note.chat.ended: The conversation ended; its commits are its record.
note.chat.cancelled: The request that started it was cancelled before its process started.
note.chat.not-kept: Daoris kept no id for its conversation, so words written to it cannot go on in it.
note.landing.accepted: Accepted automatically when its quest was done: its work is on `{{branch}}`.
note.landing.plugin-unready: Accepted automatically when its quest was done: its work is on `{{branch}}`, and `{{plugin}}` cannot land work here, so nothing was pushed; `trees hand` gives it the branch once it can.
note.landing.plugin-failed: Accepted automatically when its quest was done: its work is on `{{branch}}`, and `{{plugin}}` did not push it.
note.landing.nothing: Its quest was done and its work made no commits, so nothing was landed.
note.landing.held: Its quest is done and held for your yes, so its work lands at the look after you release it.
note.landing.uncommitted: Not accepted automatically: its tree holds uncommitted work (paths: {{paths}}), which a branch would leave behind. Commit it in the tree or tell the session, then Accept lands it.
note.landing.exists: Not accepted automatically: `{{branch}}` is already a branch, and Daoris does not move it. It waits for your review.
note.landing.refused: Not accepted automatically: the landing was refused, as follows. It waits for your review.
note.landing.unreviewed: Not accepted automatically: its work waits for your review before it lands, as follows. It lands at the first look after you review it or skip the review.
note.landing.opinion: Not accepted automatically: its work waits for a second opinion before it lands, as follows. It lands at the first look once the opinion is settled, or you go on without one.
note.landing.no-tree: Its quest was done, and it worked in the repository's own checkout, so its work is already there: nothing lands automatically.
note.landing.not-done: It did not end on a done, so nothing lands automatically: its work waits for your review.
note.ledger.parked: It stopped to ask the person; its question is in its transcript.
note.ledger.went-on: Went on with your words at {{at}}.
